description: This file defines a WorktreeManager class for managing git worktrees associated with agent sessions, including creation, discovery, commit, removal, and session ID handling, with integration into VSCode and filesystem operations.

classes.name: WorktreeError
classes.description: Custom error class for worktree-related errors, including an error code.

classes.name: WorktreeManager
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing git worktrees, including creation, discovery, commit, removal, and session ID management.

methods.name: generateBranchName
methods.description: Generates a sanitized, timestamped branch name from a prompt string.

methods.name: createWorktree
methods.description: Creates a new git worktree, optionally from an existing branch or with a generated name.

methods.name: stageAllChanges
methods.description: Stages all changes in a specified worktree and returns whether changes are staged.

methods.name: hasStagedChanges
methods.description: Checks if a worktree has staged changes.

methods.name: commitStagedChanges
methods.description: Commits staged changes in a worktree with a message.

methods.name: commitChanges
methods.description: Stages and commits all changes in a worktree, with optional message.

methods.name: removeWorktree
methods.description: Removes a worktree, with fallback to force removal if needed.

methods.name: discoverWorktrees
methods.description: Discovers existing worktrees in the designated directory.

methods.name: getWorktreeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific worktree directory.

methods.name: getWorktreeDiff
methods.description: Gets the diff between a worktree's HEAD and its parent branch.

methods.name: writeSessionId
methods.description: Writes a session ID to the worktree's session-id file and updates git exclude.

methods.name: readSessionId
methods.description: Reads the session ID from a worktree's session-id file.

methods.name: removeSessionId
methods.description: Removes the session ID file from a worktree.

methods.name: ensureWorktreeGitExclude
methods.description: Ensures the worktree's .kilocode directory is excluded from git.

methods.name: ensureWorktreesDir
methods.description: Ensures the worktrees directory exists.

methods.name: ensureGitExclude
methods.description: Ensures the main repository's exclude file includes the worktrees directory.

methods.name: resolveGitDir
methods.description: Resolves the main git directory, handling worktree references.

methods.name: isValidWorktree
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a valid git worktree.

methods.name: getCurrentBranch
methods.description: Retrieves the current branch name.

methods.name: branchExists
methods.description: Checks if a branch exists in the repository.

methods.name: getDefaultBranch
methods.description: Detects the default branch of the repository, trying remote HEAD or main/master.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the VSCode output channel.
